OrderStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a per-farm order (HLD section 11).

PLACED -> CONFIRMED -> PACKED -> QC_PASSED -> READY_FOR_DISPATCH is issue #13. After that
logistics drives it: POOLED (pool assigned), IN_TRANSIT (picked up), DELIVERED, COMPLETED.

A mock payment. In this project it always succeeds unless the amount is a test value.

intent is created, so `status` is already SUCCEEDED or FAILED in the response.

get.description:
Orders in READY_FOR_DISPATCH whose delivery date is `date` or earlier.

The shape is what the logistics pooling job reads (snake_case keys, not the public camelCase):
`order_id`, `hub_lat`/`hub_lng` (where the farm hands the produce over), `drop_lat`/`drop_lng`
(the customer's address), `weight_kg` and `address`. Once logistics publishes `pool.assigned`
the order moves to POOLED and no longer shows up here.
TODO(M1): `weight_kg` adds up the quantities of all items whatever their unit.

post.description: The harvest order is created when the quality check passes (status PLACED, no option). DELIVERY needs `deliveryAddress` (and optionally `deliveryDate`): the order becomes READY_FOR_DISPATCH and is pooled like any order; the balance (total minus deposit) is charged when it is delivered. BUYBACK: the farmer buys the harvest, the customer is credited and the order is COMPLETED. Repeating the same choice returns the order.

post.description: kind FULL (default): pay for a checkout; the intent stays PENDING until POST /orders uses it. kind DEPOSIT: pay the deposit of an accepted land reservation (`referenceId` is the reservation id, `amount` must equal its deposit); the mock gateway takes it at once, so `status` in the response is SUCCEEDED (or FAILED for the test amount) and the land service activates the reservation. BALANCE and REFUND are created by the order service.
